entry: Long only: buy on a break above the highest high of the last 20 days.
exit: Trailing exit at the lowest low of the last 10 days. Exit at whichever of the trailing level and the initial stop is higher.
stop_loss: Initial stop at 2 ATR below entry, fixed for the trade, using a 20-day Wilder ATR.
filters: Trading days run 17:00 to 17:00 New York, and bands and ATR use completed days only.
Optional day-trading mode: flat at 16:30 New York, re-enter from 18:00 if price is still above the stop.
